fare_rules.concessions: Single-journey ticket Rs70. Express buses running on feeder routes: flat Rs55. Senior citizens (60+) 50% with special card; children under 5 free with parents (2024 reports).

open_questions: Peshawar: corridor stopping pattern of express routes ER01, ER09, ER10, ER12, XER15 was read from the April 2025 network map and needs confirmation (Zu app / TransPeshawar).
Peshawar: whether the flat Rs55 'express on feeder routes' fare applies to ER01/XER15 (corridor-only express); 2025 news cited Rs70 for express routes.
Peshawar: new feeder routes on Ring Road, Dilzak Road and Khyber Road approved May 2026 plus new buses; codes/stops not yet published.
Peshawar: DR14 loop direction in Regi Model Town and whether DR14A serves all shared DR14 stops.
Peshawar: Wikipedia '8 feeder routes / 68 km' and older plan codes (1A-1H) are superseded by the 19-route v46 map; launch dates for most DR routes not found.
Sindh: fares, hours and headways for non-Karachi PBS routes are not published by SMTA; SMTA 'via' lists mix stops with areas/roads and sometimes repeat stops.
Sindh: Hyderabad Pink (women-only) bus announced Feb 2023 - no evidence it operates in 2026; no Hyderabad EV bus found.
Sindh: Nawabshah route 2 (Wikipedia) not in SMTA 2026 directory - possibly discontinued or merged.
Quetta: the 18 Green Bus stop names, current route structure after 2025-26 expansion, and pink bus route are not published online.
Turbat: route terminals/stops and fare not published.
KP other cities (Mardan, Swat/Mingora, Abbottabad, D.I. Khan): only feasibility studies / ADB mass-transit plans found (2025); no operational govt urban bus found.

AJK Muzaffarabad: green electric buses provided by Punjab govt, terminal inspected Aug 2026 - launch and routes not yet confirmed (Tribune 2026-08-29). Muzaffarabad-Gilgit intercity bus (2023) is not an urban service.
Gilgit-Baltistan: no operational government urban bus service found.
